summary: Globavend Holdings Ltd filed a 6-K reporting entry into a Standby Equity Purchase Agreement with YA II PN, Ltd., an institutional investor. The SEPA provides up to $20M commitment over 36 months, with share purchases at a discount to VWAP (93% of same-day VWAP or 96% of lowest daily VWAP over three days). No mandatory minimum draws; a 4.99% beneficial ownership cap applies. A $35K structuring fee and $200K commitment fee are payable. The proceeds will support general corporate purposes. Registration of resale shares is required before draws. Watch dilution and potential price pressure from periodic discounted issuances.
